column1: # every test case of base/freebsd_tests/groups.txt's directories, as kyua runs
# it on //images:freebsd_test_disk, with its expected result. PROGRAM:CASE
# (PROGRAM under /usr/tests) TAB RESULT TAB REASON. RESULT is PASS, XFAIL (an
# ATF expected failure), FAIL, BROKEN, SKIP, KILLED (kyua's timeout) or FLAKY
# (any result). Reasons start with a category: Apple flag, Apple behaviour,
# Apple chown/chflags/ps/stat (another Apple program the test uses), missing
# feature, environment (HFS+, the QEMU guest), FreeBSD kernel, equivalent
# (the row's program is another implementation, as pfctl), or FreeBSD's own
# P4-21's exit (docs/architecture/freebsd-parity.md §2.1): every reason of a
# case that isn't PASS or XFAIL starts with its class, before the category:
# "structural: " (decided: an Apple implementation, an equivalent, HFS+, a
# subsystem §5 puts out of scope such as jails and UFS, Darwin's or xnu's
# semantics, a program replaced by decision as devd by launchd, FreeBSD's own
# architecture limits; counts as passing), "fixable: " (anything else: Perl
# and other ports, tmpfs, cd9660 and msdosfs, md(4), the nobody uid, a data
# file, a bug; blocks its row) or "timing: " (a FLAKY case that fails only
